content: उद्वर्तनम् .²1 Going up, rising. .²2 Springing up, growth (of plants, grain <ab>&c.</ab>) .²3 Prosperity, elevation. .²4 Turning from side to side; springing up, popping the head; चटुलशफरोद्वर्तनप्रेक्षितानि <ls>Me. 42</ls>. .²5 Grinding, pounding. .²6 Drawing out metal, wire-drawing. .²7 Anointing, smearing; करोद्वर्तनार्थे चन्दनं समर्पयामि; <ab>cf.</ab> also सायणʼs commentary on the Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 12. 8. 3. 16.-- सर्वसुरभिचन्दनादि उन्मर्दनम् उद्वर्तनं यजमानस्य भवति . .²8 Particularly, rubbing and cleaning the body with perfumes or fragrant unguents, or the unguents used for this purpose or to relieve pain; नाक्रामेद्रक्तविण्मूत्रष्ठीवनोद्वर्तनादि च <ls>Y. 1. 152</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 132</ls> (अभ्यङ्गमलापकर्षणपिष्टकादि <ls>Kull.</ls>). In this connection the meaning ‘vomiting’ seems appropriate, along with other filthy objects; <ab>cf.</ab> उद्वृत्त = vomited. .²9 Bad behaviour or conduct, rudeness.
